      • load

        public void load(Properties props,
                 InputStream in)
          throws IOException,
                 InvalidPropertiesFormatException
        从类复制的说明: XmlPropertiesProvider
        Loads all of the properties represented by the XML document on the specified input stream into a properties table.
        指定者:
        load 在类中 XmlPropertiesProvider
        参数:
        props - the properties table to populate
        in - the input stream from which to read the XML document
        抛出:
        IOException - if reading from the specified input stream fails
        UnsupportedEncodingException - if the document's encoding declaration can be read and it specifies an encoding that is not supported
        InvalidPropertiesFormatException - Data on input stream does not constitute a valid XML document with the mandated document type.
        另请参阅:
        Properties.loadFromXML(java.io.InputStream)

      • store

        public void store(Properties props,
                  OutputStream os,
                  String comment,
                  String encoding)
           throws IOException
        从类复制的说明: XmlPropertiesProvider
        Emits an XML document representing all of the properties in a given table.
        指定者:
        store 在类中 XmlPropertiesProvider
        参数:
        props - the properies to store
        os - the output stream on which to emit the XML document.
        comment - a description of the property list, can be @{code null}
        encoding - the name of a supported character encoding
        抛出:
        IOException - if writing to the specified output stream fails
        UnsupportedEncodingException - if the encoding is not supported by the implementation
        另请参阅:
        Properties.storeToXML(java.io.OutputStream, java.lang.String)
